question_text:
The underlined statement has four reasons for its justification. Write the serial number of the reason you think correct:
Modern cars are equipped with Crumple Zones because:-
options: (1) They make the car look more aerodynamic and sporty.
(2) They absorb the energy of an impact, protecting the occupants in a crash.
(3) They are designed to store extra luggage in tight spaces.
(4) They help the car bounce back and stay in motion after hitting a wall.
explanation: They absorb impact energy to protect occupants.

question_text:
The underlined statement has four reasons for its justification. Write the serial number of the reason you think correct:
We add salt to the roads during heavy snowfall because:-
options: (1) It changes the color of the snow to make it easier for drivers to see.
(2) It lowers the freezing point of water, causing the ice to melt even at sub-zero temperatures.
(3) It provides a pleasant seasoning for the local wildlife.
(4) Salt particles act as tiny anchors that hold the tires to the ground.
explanation: It lowers the freezing point of water to melt ice.
